scope: Additive Scattershot direct-hit and rear-cone baseline.

sources.title: Scattershot
sources.limitations: Reports the 90-degree rear cone, one- and five-tile falloff boundaries and same-altitude restriction, but has no immutable client build, projectile lifecycle or deterministic tie/order trace.

sources.title: Scattershot payload
sources.limitations: Pins level values, direct and cone damage tables, normal cadence and footprint; no flight or reload state.

support.note: Core materializes the documented direct impact and rear-cone damage with source-backed geometry and altitude filtering through one serialised logical projectile path. Ammunition, flight, collision, client target selection and tick order remain partial.

known_uncertainties: No consulted public source supplies ammunition, reload/depletion or shot-interruption rules.
Projectile trajectory, speed, collision width, target-loss and retarget timing remain unpublished.
Cone boundary inclusivity, client target selection and same-tick damage ordering are not reproducibly documented.
conclusion: Scattershot has a shared-Core direct-impact/rear-cone baseline with official qualitative and secondary quantitative evidence; unmeasured lifecycle and client geometry remain partial.
